verdict.rationale: The pack documents a CLI arguments reference and notes that default arguments are bundled into each llamafile. The only options it lists are HTTP server, API, Web UI, slot, and sandbox settings. Nothing in the pack documents memory locking, mmap, or other low-level engine overrides, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
